name: Agent Drawer
author: salomonmay
description: A floating default-agent TUI under the menubar, with a panel for its size, usage and toggle shortcut.

barWidget.description: Left click opens the settings and usage panel. Right click slides the agent drawer in or out. Middle click restarts it.

schema.label: Toggle shortcut
schema.description: Keys that slide the drawer in and out, in the form SUPER + SHIFT + A. Leave empty to switch the shortcut off. The binding is written to the marked region at the end of ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua, replacing anything bound to the previous shortcut.
